scope: Original HABS PA-5346-A measured guest-house sheets; imperial levels converted exactly to meters. Model alignment and whole-site floor relationship remain interpreted.

canopy.basis: Native covered-walk outline and original HABS photographs1,2,5,6; stepped horizontal sections with thin supports, not continuous sloping roof beams.
canopy.floorHeightsStatus: Original main-house sheets5/6 identify the north upper-floor bridge and curved stair, separate from the first-floor entry. The U-shaped stepped approach is interpreted between that landing and the unchanged guest threshold, using original HABS photographs/site plan. Source-interpolated ground and local excavation still need review.

guestPlan.axis: Plan right is model +X; plan up is model -Z. Retains the previous covered-walk attachment coordinate.
guestPlan.basis: Relative dimensions read from original HABS sheets1-4. Polygon partitions are manually reconciled plan proportions, not a georeferenced survey. Native Protomaps outline remains an independent, generalized comparison.
guestPlan.scope: Low guest rooms, staff/car-court return with exposed apron, angled theater/upper terrace, front pergola and pool; exterior medium-fi interpretation of original HABS plans.
guestPlan.poolBasis: HABS sheets1/2 put the rounded pool beside the southeast terrace, in front of the east end rather than behind the wing. Sheets3/4 give coping +2ft5.75in; original government photo22 confirms the raised cream tub and west stone steps.

terraceConnection.basis: Original government HABS PA-5346-A first-floor plan sheet1 and original photo22. Stone terrace connects front room doors to the raised pool west steps and continues behind the pool. Widths and return are manually interpreted within the retained guest plan; no ground fitting.
terraceConnection.limitations: Simplified paving edge, slab thickness and three down-steps are architectural interpretations; not a georeferenced landscape survey. No terrain suppression or field modification is authorized by this terrace.

carCourtApproach.basis: Original HABS PA-5346-A first-floor plan and west elevation/section show an exposed lower car court at the staff return. A bounded stone-paved apron and short approach reveal those bays against native source-interpolated ground. The 3.2m exterior apron width and 3m approach run are medium-fi interpretations, not surveyed driveway dimensions.

guestFloorBasis.basis: Unchanged USGS approach ground at[-2.8,-27] plus interpreted0.54m exterior threshold. Guest absolute floor is unchanged; the main-house datum is now403.4939m at the actual first-floor loggia instead of407.0835m behind the house. Not a surveyed combined-site floor.

interpretationLimits: Raster plan traces and geographic alignment are approximate; imperial relative floor levels use exact meter conversions.
Guest absolute floor retains an interpreted exterior threshold above independent native ground, not a combined-site floor survey.
Rock cuts, car-court apron width, driveway stub and paving foundations represent exterior topology, not a geological or civil survey.
